input.question: Defend the Spend review of pr-015: please itemize the lab supplies and publication costs in this request with vendors and dates, and confirm each was allocable to R21AI000002 and placed before the project end date.

purchases.item: Open-access publication fee, J. Appl. Microb. Methods

answer.answer: Payment request pr-015 (period 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30, total $8,410) charges grant R21AI000002, whose project end date is 2026-08-01. Lab supplies: rq-033, Agar plates, 40 packs, vendor MicroMedia, ordered 2026-04-14, $1,180, aim: Assay validation runs. Invoice paid, $1,180, received 2026-04-20. Publication costs: rq-035, Open-access publication fee, J. Appl. Microb. Methods, vendor J. Appl. Microb. Methods, ordered 2026-04-24, $2,100, aim: Publishing the beta-lactam assay paper. Invoice paid, $2,100, received 2026-04-30. Timing: both order dates (2026-04-14 and 2026-04-24) fall before the project end date of 2026-08-01. Allocability: each purchase is tied in the records to a research aim of this grant (assay validation runs for rq-033, publishing the beta-lactam assay paper for rq-035). The records do not include any further allocability documentation, so any stronger confirmation would need the grant manager's review. Other items: the request also includes personnel rows pay-R21-2026-04-1 (research technician, 60% effort, $2,880) and pay-R21-2026-04-2 (graduate researcher, 50% effort, $2,250), which were not part of the question. The records also show that 1 item was left out of this request, and I cannot say from these records what that item is or whether it is a lab supply or publication cost. The records also do not show how the listed items relate to the $8,410 total, and I have not computed it.
